create_upsert_response: upsert a cached response into MongoDB with content, HTTP status, and metadata for a given job kind and dataset
create_get_response: get a cached response from MongoDB by kind, dataset, config, and split, returning content and metadata
create_get_cache_reports: get paginated cache reports with cursor-based pagination for a given cache kind, excluding or including content
create_delete_dataset_responses: delete all cached responses for a dataset and decrement associated metrics for each removed entry
create_get_cache_entries_df: fetch cached responses for a dataset as a Pandas DataFrame with optional filtering by cache kinds
